allowed: New recovery-only pure indicator kernels with exact frozen initialization, recurrence, warmup and invalid-input behavior.
New recovery-only replay/consumer transitions with identical decisions, causal input access, terminal states, order and complete native provenance.
Append-only indexed views, per-invocation caches, incremental validation/indexes and accumulated reporting replacing repeated scans/copies, with exactly equivalent invariant enforcement.
Streaming exact canonical serialization and cached bytes, preserving the complete frozen native schema, key ordering, integer spelling, UTF-8 and final LF.
every_replacement_requires: Frozen source path/SHA and symbol plus exact input/output/status/error and availability contract.
Induction/algebra proof for exact recurrence and invariant-preserving transition semantics, including exception and terminal idempotence behavior.
Independent reference differential tests on predeclared invented inputs; exact comparison without tolerances.
Explicit version, independent source SHA, full dependency closure binding, and attribution to the distinct recovery runtime.
forbidden: Edits to frozen components, assembly, original runner, strategy manifest, DEVELOPMENT protocol or thresholds.
Monkeypatching, rebinding imported functions, dynamic alteration of frozen globals, AST rewriting/cloning to disguise a replacement as the original runtime.
Changed comparisons, periods, warmup, thresholds, invalid-input precedence, event ordering, ownership, quantities, stops, executions, exits or costs.
Floating-point indicators, Decimal-rounded recurrences, tolerance-based trading decisions or silently rounded prices.
Reset/truncation across gaps, interpolation, synthetic bars, data repair, session filtering or removal of July 4 stored observation.
Shrinking the result schema, replacing required native values with symbolic references, omitting or deduplicating required lifecycle records.
Any real data benchmark, replay, result selection, OOS access, broker access or automatic retry in this gate.

cost_analysis.evidence_size_risk: If O(n) required records contain rationals whose decimal encodings grow O(n), aggregate numeric text alone may be O(n^2); nested repeated provenance can increase it. This is a workload-conditional structural bound, not a claim that the canonical dataset has those records.
cost_analysis.feasibility_status: NOT_ESTABLISHED; no new engine, workload benchmark or real recovery result exists.

formula_witness.implication: Even a single tick impulse followed by constant prices can keep growing exact denominators; a constant-from-seed control is insufficient.
formula_witness.input: Invented integer P=20000 for indices 0..19, P+1/4 at index 20, then P forever.
formula_witness.reduced_denominator: 42 * 21**m exactly, since gcd(19,42*21)=1 and P is integral.

cost_analysis.fraction_work: Reduced numerators/denominators can grow linearly in bit length with index. GCD, cross-multiplication, division and decimal encoding have operand-size dependent cost; O(n) recurrence steps does not establish O(n) wall time.
cost_analysis.lifecycle_and_serialization: Required native snapshots repeat nested rational provenance. All records must remain; snapshot sharing internally cannot remove repeated required JSON values. Repeated canonicalization/hash/schema validation and decimal-chunk conversion amplify cost.
cost_analysis.materialization: Assembly rebuilds RAW/price/rejection maps and copies closed-bar/raw-decision tuples; books revalidate full histories and search nested provenance. Repeated nested joins may grow faster than a single history scan.
cost_analysis.reference_prefix_work: Repeated evaluation through i reprocesses 0..i. At one call per bar, total recurrence count can be quadratic; actual calls depend on lifecycle. Whole-call memoization at different terminal indices does not eliminate it.

tick_grid_denominator_envelopes.assumption: Invented valid closes are integers/4. These are divisor envelopes, not observed real-data denominators or timings. Cancellation may reduce actual values.
tick_grid_denominator_envelopes.method: Exact integer exponentiation and bit_length only, without float/log approximations or market observations.

design_options_only.compare: Exact rational comparisons only; retain current and previous indicator values and statuses.
design_options_only.decode: The state is already the exact reduced Fraction; one actual observation advances one recurrence.
design_options_only.risk: Removes prefix recomputation but not big-integer arithmetic or repeated native evidence size.

design_options_only.compare: Compare by provably equal integer cross-products or a proven common exact denominator; equality remains exact.
design_options_only.decode: Exact signed integer numerator and positive factored denominator decode to a reduced Fraction by integer arithmetic/GCD. Validate canonical source decimal conversion exactly.
design_options_only.risk: Unreduced integers may be larger. Factored denominators can avoid repeated factor construction/GCD but cannot erase numerator information or expansion required by the native schema.

design_options_only.compare: Require a rigorous terminating exact sign/equality algorithm; an undecided sign cannot pass a trading predicate. Full exact fallback must itself fit resource limits.
design_options_only.decode: Finite versioned acyclic seed/recurrence graph whose nodes denote exact rationals; exact terminating decoder emits the same reduced numerator/denominator.
design_options_only.risk: Symbolic compactness is not a proof of fast comparison/decoding. No symbolic node may replace a required native rational in the frozen output.

design_options_only.compare: Snapshot equivalence and full canonical normalized result equality; exact output hash before normalization.
design_options_only.decode: Per-invocation state/indexes plus an append-only audit ledger decode to every historical reference record in identical order.
design_options_only.risk: No record deletion, schema change or hidden session filter. On-disk streaming can bound memory while full evidence bytes and decoding time remain potentially large.

equivalence_plan.candidate: Future distinct optimized engine and complete source closure, not yet implemented.
coverage: Exact and immediately adjacent thresholds; EMA19/20 and MACD34/35 actual-close warmup boundaries.
LONG/SHORT mirrors; impulse and reversal; ambiguous and same-direction dual events.
Contexts e/e+1/e+8/e+9 and elapsed-time boundaries; no refresh, opposite/ambiguous invalidation before same-bar consumption.
Pending A/B competition; first consumed pullback lock; suppressed signals never queue; release/admission ordering and idempotence.
Confirmation k/k+1/k+2/k+3, price/momentum equality and expiry; entry q/q+1 and invalid/gapped/missing next Open.
Risk quantity 1/2/rejection, $50/$100 equalities and adjacent exact tick-valid values, future-Open independence.
Stop intrabar touch/gap/breached-entry cases; gap stop priority over pending EMA exit; exit on entry-bar Close and next Open.
Long clock gaps, absent required indexed observations, unclosed/nonfinite/malformed inputs, and exact reference failure precedence.
Invented off-session observation processed, never filtered; no session reset, reindexing, filling or repair.
Open/Close/future-field access sentinels; future mutation has no prior effect; repeated processing and terminal irreversibility.
End of input with context, pending confirmation/entry/EMA exit and open position, no liquidation.
One/two-contract cost exactness, loss/breakeven streak reset, PF ZERO/POSITIVE_INFINITY, drawdown, equal elapsed-time segmentation and exit-timestamp attribution.
Fraction denominator-growth pulses, alternating prices and nonconstant bounded tick-grid paths, not only constant controls.
equivalence_plan.fixture_selection: Predeclare and hash fixture generator, seeds, lengths and scenario inventory before candidate results; no profitability-based selection or removal of failing fixtures.
protocol: Bind hashes and verify fixture bytes equal before each independent reference/candidate run.
Compare pure values and per-Open/per-Close snapshot decisions/status/error/read boundaries first; do not accept metrics-only equality.
Run every full lifecycle scenario at least twice from fresh invocation/process state; no shared mutable cache.
Require the complete reference and candidate native payloads and validate each original output_sha256 over canonical payload excluding that field BEFORE any normalization.

Normalize ONLY run_identity.runner_source_sha256 and run_id_sha256 to the same deterministic reference identity; recompute the derived output_sha256. All dataset/strategy/protocol bindings and every strategy/result field stay equal.
Compare canonical normalized UTF-8 bytes with final LF and their hashes exactly. Keep each pre-normalization hash and source identity in separate evidence.

For long streams, use fixed indicator-prefix oracle checkpoints and algebraic proofs in addition to complete small-scenario comparisons; these are explicitly not an exhaustive reference replay at 89841 bars. A missing proof, omitted field, undecided equality or failed reference/candidate case blocks implementation PASS.
equivalence_plan.reference: Hashed original runner, assembly, 13 components and screening source in reference_sources.

failure_governance.after_future_claim_failure: Claim remains terminal and attempt consumed; preserve receipts; STOP for AGIcoreManager. No restart/resume/second recovery/third invocation.
failure_governance.binding_or_scope_failure: STOP_BLOCKED_GOVERNANCE_OR_PROTOCOL_CONFLICT; no hash rewrite or silent exception extension.
failure_governance.equivalence_failure: STOP_BLOCKED_SEMANTIC_EQUIVALENCE; keep all counterexamples, logs and original evidence; no tolerance or favorable-case selection.
failure_governance.resource_failure: STOP_BLOCKED_TECHNICAL_FEASIBILITY; keep partial synthetic artifacts; no approximation, schema shrink or real-data feasibility experiment.
failure_governance.rollback: Reject the candidate for execution; retain failed/versioned evidence and the untouched reference. No destructive worktree rollback or resurrection of the original execution claim.

mathematical_invariants.accounting_and_screening_authority: Unchanged DEVELOPMENT protocol metric_contract/result_schema and frozen screening source. Every actual Close marked once, open effective entry plus paid fee only, three equal elapsed-time segments by exit-fill timestamp; diagnostics never alter admission/verdict.
mathematical_invariants.authority: All formulas and constants below are explanatory assertions against the hashed specification, never new configurable parameters.

lifecycle.authority: Frozen assembly and 13 gate source hashes, including the pending-opportunity policy, determine actual causal ordering.
lifecycle.confirmation: k+1..k+2 only and <=2 minutes; first passing candidate.
lifecycle.context: One shot; e+1..e+8 inclusive and <=8 minutes; opposite/ambiguous invalidation precedes consumption.
lifecycle.costs: One adverse 0.25-point tick per actual fill and $0.51 per contract/fill; no second slippage subtraction.
lifecycle.entry: q+1 Open only and <=1 minute; quantity frozen at Close[q], immutable structural stop k..q plus one tick.
lifecycle.invalid_input: Preserve reference statuses/errors, fail-closed precedence and permitted-field reads; missing required indexed observations are not repaired.
lifecycle.order: Each actual Open then its Close; entry/bind/breach, opening stop before EMA market exit, adverse stop before close decisions; pending owner is resolved before new admission exactly as the frozen pending policy.
lifecycle.pending_lock: FIRST_CONSUMED_PULLBACK_LOCKS; at most one actionable pending opportunity, no replacement, refresh or queue.
lifecycle.risk: MNQ 1 or 2 contracts; planned structural budget $100 based only on Close[q].
lifecycle.stop_priority: STRUCTURAL_STOP > pending EMA20 exit at an opening gap; stop remains active across time/session gaps.

macd.comparisons: All four frozen directional strict comparisons, including previous MACD/histogram; no crossover or magnitude requirement.

new_runtime_design.attribution: A distinct recovery runtime implementing tested computational equivalents of the hashed reference specification. The historical frozen assembly remains SYNTHETIC_ONLY and is not claimed to execute recovery if it is only used as an oracle.
layers: Default-deny authorization/identity boundary and exact byte loader, preserving every actual observation.
Invocation-owned exact indicator state and versioned pure decision contracts.
Equivalent Open/Close lifecycle reducer with append-only immutable snapshots and indexed provenance, plus incrementally equivalent invariant validation.
Exact accounting/marks, complete native result materialization/streaming, frozen metrics/schema and deterministic canonical output.
Exclusive recovery claim, durable progress and terminal receipt supervision only after future explicit authorization.

source_hash_policy.bundle: Canonical sorted path-to-SHA dependency-closure manifest plus runtime/dependency versions; bind its hash in implementation evidence, readiness and future authorization before claim/data access.
source_hash_policy.drift: Any changed dependency invalidates prior equivalence/readiness, even if entrypoint/run ID bytes remain identical. No post-result code replacement or result shopping.
source_hash_policy.entrypoint: Independent SHA-256 of exact final entrypoint bytes, never the original runner hash.
source_hash_policy.helpers: Inventory and hash every new executable module, serializer, validator, fixture generator and locally imported dependency; no unbound changed code. Bind frozen dependencies to reference hashes.
source_hash_policy.run_identity: Keep the original four-field sorted compact UTF-8 + final LF identity structure. runner_source_sha256 is the new entrypoint hash. Auxiliary-source bundle hash is an additional mandatory authorization/evidence binding; it does not silently redefine run identity.

parent_protocol.precedence: Apply only the enumerated computational exception. Every other parent requirement remains binding; conflicts outside this scope fail closed. This is a design precommit, never an execution authorization.
parent_protocol.reason: The previous gate required composition through unchanged consumers and assembly. Those APIs cannot accept incremental indicator values. A separate engine computing equivalent transitions exceeds orchestration-only composition; this addendum explicitly permits that computational substitution in a future authorized implementation, without declaring literal runtime/source identity.

preserved_work.prior_evidence_semantics: Historical BLOCKED snapshot kept byte-identical and published with this documentary PR; it is not rewritten as a successful implementation.
preserved_work.prior_state_preservation: Exact checkpoint preserved before editing current-state header; all historical sections, including the blocked implementation, retained.

root_conflict.smallest_conflict: The frozen pullback, confirmation and EMA exit functions call full-prefix EMA/MACD evaluators internally. Their signatures accept bars, not a prior indicator state, a precomputed exact evaluation, or a caller-owned evaluator. Reusing those functions for a new requested prefix repeats the original historical work; eliminating that work requires an authorized indicator injection/continuation interface or replacing the internal calls/predicates. No such replacement is made.

acceptance: All families and sizes complete within bounds twice, with identical canonical result hashes and all required measurements.
Report arithmetic operand growth, final materialization/encoding/validation time and output bytes; recurrence step count alone is insufficient.

Project CPU/wall time, memory, disk/output and serialization requirements for 89841 actual observations from all measured nonconstant/dense cases and symbolic bounds; label estimates, method, residual uncertainty and headroom explicitly.

Confirm deployment host measured capacities and durable supervised execution fit conservative estimates plus explicit headroom. If bounds/capacity or output feasibility are unproven, BLOCKED_TECHNICAL_FEASIBILITY.
No real recovery until equivalence, resource evidence, registration, readiness and distinct explicit execution authorization all pass.

bounded_execution.measurement_failure: Missing measurement or inability to enforce a required bound blocks feasibility; no automatic relaxation or omitted workload.
bounded_execution.semantics: Infrastructure safety caps only, no trading parameter. Supervisor records timeout/resource failure and retains logs. These values do not promise availability in Work; a suitable durable host must be demonstrated before testing/execution.

scalability_plan.durable_logs: Versioned synthetic fixture identity, source closure, environment and supervisor command fixed before start; persist process START/progress/END/timeout with UTC and Open/Close phase and last completed index, never relabel process liveness as bar progress. Logs/receipts survive Work session loss and remain immutable/hash-bound.
scalability_plan.schema_feasibility_blocker: FULL_EXACT_NATIVE_EVIDENCE_FEASIBILITY_UNPROVEN; if computation completes but complete frozen output cannot be decoded/serialized/validated within demonstrated resources, stop BLOCKED_TECHNICAL_FEASIBILITY. Do not shrink schema or omit lifecycle.
